# `cbo_eval_baselines`

**CBO historical baseline projections**

All CBO historical baseline budget projections across 1982-2026 vintages used as inputs to forecast evaluation.

**Coverage.** True range. Complete US-CBO/eval-projections input_data/baselines.csv spanning February 1982 through February 2026 baselines and projected fiscal years 1982-2036, including non-Spring/non-Winter baselines and unrealized future years. *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `cbo_eval_baselines.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | `VARCHAR` | Budget component (outlay, revenue, deficit, or debt). |
| `category` | `VARCHAR` | Major budget category or Total. |
| `subcategory` | `VARCHAR` | Budget subcategory or Total. |
| `baseline_date` | `DATE` | Year and month of the CBO baseline release (day fixed to 01 per CBO convention). |
| `spring_flag` | `BOOLEAN` | True when CBO designates the baseline as that year's Spring baseline. |
| `winter_flag` | `BOOLEAN` | True when CBO designates the baseline as that year's Winter baseline. |
| `projected_fiscal_year` | `BIGINT` | Target federal fiscal year projected by the baseline. |
| `projected_year_number` | `BIGINT` | Forecast horizon relative to the baseline release (-1 through 11). |
| `projected_value_billions` | `DOUBLE` | Unadjusted CBO baseline projection in billions of dollars. |
| `source_commit` | `VARCHAR` | Pinned 40-character Git commit SHA of US-CBO/eval-projections. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Immutable raw GitHub URL for input_data/baselines.csv at source_commit. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of input_data/baselines.csv bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC capture timestamp with timezone. |
